title: Kenen: asking about one owner
focus: Ask about one owner with kenen: Kenen kirja tämä on? (“Whose book is this?”).
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive

parts.formation: Use kenen to ask about one owner. kirja names the single thing owned.
